name: Tessek Tamarind-Black Pepper Gummies
description: Irregularly shaped gummies with a tamarind-sour exterior dusted in cracked black pepper sugar, yielding a soft, chewy center with a slow-building heat. Sold in 80g resealable pouches.
flavor_profile: Intensely sour tamarind front, followed by a warm, cracked-pepper finish that lingers without burning — complex and addictive
slogan: Sour first. Then it gets interesting.
cultural_context: One of the rare candies genuinely available across all tiers — Tessek's distribution network is exceptionally wide, and the flavor profile hits a cultural sweet spot that crosses demographic lines. Tier 5 consumers sometimes buy them 'ironically' and then continue buying them. Tessek is a mid-size independent brand that has resisted three acquisition attempts from corponations.
story_hooks: Tessek Candy Co.'s refusal to sell to a major corponation has made its founder a target — she's received threats, and her distribution trucks have been sabotaged twice in the past month.

A Tier 1 child has been collecting Tessek pouch seals, which feature micro-printed city maps as a promotional gimmick — one seal in the current run contains a map of a section of the Shelf that doesn't officially exist.
The tamarind supply chain for Tessek runs through a vertical farm cooperative in the lower Tier 2 district that is quietly operating as a sanctuary for undocumented gene-modded individuals.
